label: Доля
description: A 10-sentence usage card for доля (share, portion).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Доля' is a feminine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Прибыли' is the genitive showing what the share is of, and 'большая' is the agreeing predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Долю' is the feminine accusative direct object. 'Свою' agrees in the accusative, and 'каждый' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет' the noun takes the genitive 'доли'. 'Своей' agrees, and 'у меня' marks who lacks the share.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'от'. 'Доли' is the genitive after 'от', the thing renounced. 'Отказался' takes a genitive complement here.
Strategic focus: Nominative in an idiom. 'Доля' is the nominative subject of 'есть', and 'правды' is the genitive completing the set phrase meaning 'a grain of truth'.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. 'Доле' is the dative after 'к', the share to which interest was added. 'Проценты' is the accusative plural object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'доволен'. 'Долей' is the instrumental required by the short adjective 'доволен'. 'Своей' agrees in the instrumental.

missions.phrase: В её доле было много долгов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В доле' uses the prepositional form 'доле' after 'в' to locate where the debts were. 'Долгов' is the genitive plural after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Доли' is the feminine nominative plural subject. 'Акций' is the genitive plural showing what kind, and 'подорожали' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural after 'на'. 'Доли' is the accusative plural after 'на', the shares the property was split into. 'Имущество' is the accusative object.
